name: task_start
description: Open a multi-worker task room as host: split a goal across worker sessions, send the round-1 task card to each worker's talk inbox, and report who is live vs inactive. Returns the room name for task_assign/collect/close. Pass exactly one of workers (existing session ids) or worker_count (auto-spawned sessions owned by this room); counts are integers.

goal.description: The work to split across workers (e.g. 'fix login retry').

workers.description: 1-8 existing worker session ids from session_list; must exist and cannot include the host. Either this or worker_count.

worker_count.description: Whole number of worker sessions to auto-spawn (1-8, e.g. 2). Fresh ids embed the room name; their databases are created by their own processes. Either this or workers.

max_rounds.description: Whole number of rounds before forced close (default 5). Rework assignments consume rounds.

room.description: Optional room name (1-64 chars); auto-generated when omitted.
